scientific_status: MECHANISM / INTEGRATION ABLATIONS, not final causal-method validation. Arm S3 does NOT validate D_psi as a propensity; arms S1/S2 have no causal propensity interpretation; one seed is not statistical validation.

shared.environment: offline_ant_umaze_rockfall, p_active=0.30, H=800, reset_fix=True, severity v2.1 (0.80/0.15/0.05)
shared.eval_protocol: scripts/diagnose_naive_rockfall.py --v2 --p-active 0.3 --reset-fix --horizon 800, n=200, FIXED eval seed bank (identical mask-pattern counts 48/45/53/54 across all runs)
shared.selector: argmin_k min_g ||norm(s_k) - norm(g)||_2 over the 16-state bank; lowest-index tie-break; no Critic C

S1.name: fixed-rate worst-case integration ablation (p_wc=0.10)
S1.purpose: Low-dose fixed-rate arm. Isolates whether the worst-case branch itself works, independently of propensity quality. p_wc = 0.10 has NO causal propensity interpretation; B ~ Bernoulli(rho = 0.90) for every transition.

S2.name: fixed-rate worst-case integration ablation (p_wc=0.50)
S2.purpose: DOSE-MATCHED CONTROL FOR D_psi, and the replacement for the dropped k=3 arm. p_wc = 0.50 has NO causal propensity interpretation; it is a fixed rate chosen to match the empirical mean branch rate of D_psi (~0.495). Comparing this arm against the D_psi arm isolates whether D_psi contributes useful STATE/ACTION DEPENDENCE beyond its mean dose: same average worst-case exposure, one state-dependent and one not.
S2.rho_semantics: fixed p_wc=0.50 (rho=0.50) -- dose-matched control, NO causal interpretation

S3.name: Dpsi surrogate propensity ablation
S3.purpose: APPROXIMATE PROPENSITY STRESS TEST. D_psi is a balanced behavior-vs-target SOURCE CLASSIFIER, NOT a calibrated causal propensity (see artifacts/static_worstcase_rl/g2_calibration_audit.json). Used frozen and raw, exactly as implemented: rho = sigmoid(logit), p_wc = 1 - rho. On the clean training transitions E[rho] ~ 0.505, so E[p_wc] ~ 0.495 -- but the realized rate is NOT forced. This arm does NOT validate D_psi as a propensity estimator.
S3.rho_semantics: D_psi raw sigmoid SURROGATE -- NOT a calibrated propensity (expected E[rho]~0.505, not forced)

S4.name: pure blind CRL baseline (clean dataset)
S4.purpose: Ordinary contrastive RL only: no propensity, no worst-case branch, no Flow, no similarity selector, no static table, NO failure-negative augmentation (alpha_fail = 0). Uses the CLEAN split so it is dataset-matched to the three worst-case arms and to the historical fail-neg-only reference. The historical blind run naive_rockfall_v2_p30_h800_resetfix_s0_300k used the FULL pilot (sha 08bdc44b...) and is kept only as a secondary, NOT dataset-matched reference.

historical_k3.name: historical k=3 propensity + worst-case
historical_k3.status: DROPPED by the user after recovery failed; REPLACED by wc_fixedp50_h800_a01_s0_300k
historical_k3.reason: no historical k=3 propensity exists anywhere in the repository, on any branch, or in git history; see artifacts/four_arm_wc_run/k3_recovery_report.md

fail_neg_only_alpha01_CLEAN.role: PRIMARY historical comparison reference -- DO NOT RERUN
fail_neg_only_alpha01_CLEAN.protocol_match: same trainer, dataset, env, seed, budget and eval protocol as the worst-case arms -- compatible, no rerun needed
fail_neg_only_alpha01_CLEAN.reporting_rule: BOTH final and best recorded; compare every new arm final-to-final and best-to-best. NEVER compare this best against a new-run final.

blind_crl_FULL_dataset.role: SECONDARY reference only -- NOT dataset-matched (FULL pilot, sha 08bdc44b...). The dataset-matched blind baseline is the new arm blind_crl_clean_h800_a00_s0_300k.

key_matched_comparison.rationale: approximately equal AVERAGE worst-case dose (fixed 0.500 vs D_psi empirical mean ~0.495). The only difference is that D_psi varies with (s, g_cmd, a) while the fixed arm does not, so the contrast isolates whether D_psi contributes useful state/action dependence BEYOND its mean branch rate.
key_matched_comparison.dose_check: confirm the realized worst-case rates in the smoke logs before launch; do NOT force D_psi to match 0.50

reporting_rule: Report final AND best for every arm from the identical eval protocol (n=200, fixed eval seed bank). Compare like with like: final-to-final and best-to-best.
